questions.stem: What is a Data Product Owner (DPO) responsible for?
options: Overseeing the development, maintenance and evolution of a data product
Writing all of the code for a data product personally
Auditing the organisation's financial statements
Managing the physical data centre
Approving employee holiday requests
questions.explanation: A Data Product Owner oversees the development, maintenance and evolution of a data product so that it serves user needs and business goals.

questions.stem: Why are business leaders such as a Chief Data Officer (CDO) or Chief Analytics Officer (CAO) considered well suited to the Data Product Owner role?
options: Because they usually write the most code
Because they typically have a deep understanding of the organisation's strategic goals and data-driven needs
Because they have no other responsibilities
Because they manage the network infrastructure
Because they are always the founders of the company
questions.explanation: CDOs and CAOs understand the organisation's strategic goals and data-driven needs, so they can align data products with business objectives.

questions.stem: In which kind of organisation is a CTO or CIO suggested as a good fit for the Data Product Owner role?
options: Organisations with no IT department
Small charities
Organisations where data products are highly technical or integrated with broader IT systems
Organisations that have banned dashboards
Organisations run entirely by founders
questions.explanation: A CTO or CIO suits organisations where data products are highly technical or integrated with broader IT systems, given their infrastructure expertise.

questions.stem: What condition is placed on a visionary founder or CEO acting as Data Product Owner?
options: They must first obtain a data science degree
They must hand the role to IT within six months
They must report to the CDO
They should have a solid understanding of data and a clear vision of how it will add value
They must be the company's largest shareholder
questions.explanation: For a visionary leader to work effectively as DPO, they should have a solid understanding of data and a clear vision of how it will add value.

questions.stem: Which candidate group for the Data Product Owner role includes Product Managers with data knowledge and senior Data Analysts?
options: Business Leaders
Technical Leaders
Data Visionaries
Dedicated Data Product Owners
Cross-Functional Managers
questions.explanation: Cross-Functional Managers such as Product Managers with data knowledge or senior Data Analysts can connect data insights, business goals and user needs.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT listed as a key skill or quality of a Data Product Owner?
options: Fluency in several foreign languages
Strategic thinking
Technical knowledge
User-centric mindset
Communication and collaboration
questions.explanation: The listed skills are strategic thinking, technical knowledge, a user-centric mindset, analytical skills, and communication and collaboration; foreign-language fluency is not among them.

questions.stem: What does a user-centric mindset mean for a Data Product Owner?
options: Prioritising the DPO's own preferences
Focusing on the end-user experience and usability
Measuring only the number of users
Restricting access to senior users only
Designing the product for the IT department first
questions.explanation: A user-centric mindset focuses on the end-user experience and the usability of the data product.

questions.stem: According to the guidance on choosing a Data Product Owner, what does the ideal choice depend on?
options: The number of offices the company has
The age of the company's database software
The organisation's data maturity, business model and specific needs
The size of the marketing budget
Whether the company is publicly listed
questions.explanation: The ideal Data Product Owner varies with the organisation's data maturity, business model and specific needs.

questions.stem: Which option does the author of I Am Datapedia! personally recommend for the Data Product Owner role?
options: Rotating the role among all managers each quarter
Assigning it to the CEO in every organisation
Leaving the role unfilled until the data product is mature
Having Dedicated Data Product Owners
Outsourcing the role to a consultancy
questions.explanation: The author's personal recommendation is Dedicated Data Product Owners, given the rapid evolution of the data and AI landscape.

questions.stem: What advantage does a Dedicated Data Product Owner offer regarding Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)?
options: The DPO is exempt from having any KPIs
KPIs are set by the consumers rather than the organisation
KPIs are replaced by OKRs
The DPO's KPIs are shared equally with every department
Someone's KPIs are directly tied to the quality, usability and impact of data products
questions.explanation: A Dedicated DPO ensures that someone's KPIs are directly tied to the quality, usability and impact of data products, driving continuous improvement.
